privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: At Fitness Zone M'sila, we collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, and fitness goals when you register through our booking forms. We also collect basic usage data through cookies to improve your browsing experience.

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
items: To contact you regarding your gym orientation and tours.
To customize your personal training and nutrition plans.
To send you important updates regarding facility hours or membership terms.
To improve our website performance and user experience.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information. Your data is stored securely and is only accessible by authorized staff members of Fitness Zone. We never sell or share your personal data with third-party marketing companies.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, update, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time. If you wish to exercise these rights, please contact us at support@fitnesszone.dz or visit our reception desk in M'sila.

privacy.footer: By using our website and services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

challengesAwards.description: At Fitness Zone, we believe in pushing every athlete to their limit — and beyond. We host regular challenges for both kids and adult athletes, and we reward every milestone with trophies, medals, and recognition that fuels the drive to keep going.
challengesAwards.bannerDesc: From junior fitness battles to adult strength competitions every challenge is designed to unlock potential, build character, and celebrate the warrior spirit in every member of our community.
challengesAwards.gallerySubtitle: Click any photo to view full-screen
challengesAwards.ctaDesc: Join our next competition and take home your award.

sections.title: Membership Agreement
sections.content: By joining Fitness Zone M'sila, you agree to abide by our facility rules and code of conduct. Membership is personal and non-transferable. You must be at least 16 years of age to join without parental consent.

sections.title: Payments & Cancellations
items: Monthly memberships are billed in advance.
Annual memberships are non-refundable after the first 14 days.
Cancellation requires a 30-day written notice via email or in person at the facility.
Late payments may result in a temporary suspension of access.

sections.title: Liability Waiver
sections.content: Physical training involves inherent risks. By using our facility and equipment, you acknowledge and accept responsibility for your physical safety. Fitness Zone is not liable for any injuries sustained during training or while on the premises, except in cases of proven gross negligence.

sections.title: Code of Conduct
sections.content: We maintain a professional and respectful environment. Harassment of staff or other members, damage to equipment, or failure to follow hygiene rules (such as using towels and re-racking weights) may result in immediate termination of membership without refund.

therapy.subtitle: Professional Therapeutic Sessions
therapy.description: Professional therapeutic sessions designed to improve recovery, reduce pain, and enhance overall performance.

items.title: Dry Cupping Therapy
items.description: A professional recovery massage designed to relieve muscle tension, improve blood circulation, and accelerate post-workout recovery. Ideal for athletes and individuals experiencing physical fatigue or stress.

items.title: Recovery Massage
items.description: A traditional therapy using suction cups to stimulate blood flow, release toxins, and reduce muscle tightness. Safe, effective, and widely used for recovery and pain management.

items.title: Fire Cupping Therapy
items.description: An advanced cupping technique using controlled heat to create suction. This method enhances detoxification, relieves deep muscle tension, and stimulates the body's natural recovery processes.
benefits: Improves energy flow in the body
Helps with back and joint pain
